name: what is in hbtns
eval: (function(){var h=document.querySelector('#hbtns');var hb=h.getBoundingClientRect();var cs=getComputedStyle(h);var out=['hbtns h='+Math.round(hb.height)+' scrollH='+h.scrollHeight+' display='+cs.display+' wrap='+cs.flexWrap+' gap='+cs.rowGap];Array.prototype.forEach.call(h.children,function(c){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();out.push('['+(c.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,14)+'] '+Math.round(r.width)+'x'+Math.round(r.height)+' top='+Math.round(r.top-hb.top))});return out.join(' | ')})()
